info.title: ZONATA Universal AI Company Operating System - V8 AI CEO Executive Operating Layer API

get.summary: List active Strategic Plans or get specific strategy by strategy_id

Missions list with KPIs, KRAs, acceptance criteria, and outcome status

get.summary: List hierarchical budget allocations across Tenant -> Company -> Department -> Mission
